messages.body_plain:

My fecObj is : fvS<-makeFecObj(SIPM,Formula=(fec2~size),Family="binomial",fecConstants
= data.frame(seedlingsPerRep=2.5),
                offspringSplitter=data.frame(continuous=0,Seedling=1),

)

and the offspringRE1 slot says:

-Kimmy Kellett
